description: Upload many images across one or more locales in a SINGLE edit. Required when seeding a newly created locale: Play validates listing completeness at commit time and demands at least 2 phone screenshots, so gpc_upload_image — which commits after every file — fails with "too few screenshots" and leaves the locale empty. Set replace to clear existing images of this type first.

imageType.description: Image type (phoneScreenshots, sevenInchScreenshots, tenInchScreenshots, tvScreenshots, wearScreenshots, icon, featureGraphic, tvBanner)

replace.description: Delete each locale's existing images of this type first, so the result is exactly the given list (default: false, appends)

filePaths.description: Absolute paths to the image files, in the order they should appear

language.description: Locale code (en-US, tr-TR, de-DE, es-419, fr-FR, ru-RU, ar)

name: gpc_upload_images_batch
